messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "do not change dose or stop unless doctor tells you to"
set: ["do not change dose or stop unless doctor tells you to", "do not stop unless doctor tells you to", "do not stop taking unless doctor tells you to", "do not change dose or stop suddenly unless you have a seizure", "do not stop taking before surgery unless surgeon tells you to", "do this unless your doctor tells you otherwise", "do not stop using carvedilol before surgery unless your surgeon tells you to", "do not change your dose or stop without talking to your doctor", "do not use more than one dose in a 24-hour period unless your doctor tells you to", "do not change your dose", "do not take for longer than your doctor tells you to", "do not change doses or stop without doctor's advice", "take with a meal unless your doctor tells you otherwise", "do not change dose without doctor's advice", "do not change your dose or stop taking it without talking to your prescriber first", "do not stop without first talking to doctor"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
JSON:

completion:
{
  "duplicates": [
    "do not stop unless doctor tells you to",
    "do not stop taking unless doctor tells you to",
    "do not change your dose or stop without talking to your doctor",
    "do not change your dose or stop taking it without talking to your prescriber first",
    "do not change dose without doctor's advice",
    "do not change doses or stop without doctor's advice",
    "do not change your dose",
    "do not stop without first talking to doctor"
  ],
  "alias": "do not change dose or stop unless doctor tells you to"
}
